## 7de2798953a7

**Reproduced teaching defect — endpoint equality shortcut.** Generator SHA `382f749f2f6a2f83cc9bffa0dbb3a0076ccf92dc25ec74365adf43cbe495acb1`; executed rule hash `3bca54d68914`.

The ordinary generator always puts two equal-colored endpoints on each active row. Therefore the plausible rival “for any row with exactly two nonzero cells and an all-zero interior, fill alternating interior positions using the left endpoint color” does not need to test endpoint equality. It matched all 4 canonical pairs and all 60 sampled ordinary inputs (seed `20261004`, 20 per difficulty band), while every sampled input passed the target validator.

The saved counterexample adds one mismatched `4 ... 6` row beside two ordinary valid pair rows. The complete grid passes the target `self_check` and is lawful for Racket execution, but it is outside the ordinary default generated distribution. The authority leaves the mismatched row unchanged; the rival paints two interior cells color 4. Evidence: `checks/audit/7de2798953a7/input.json`, `racket.json`, `rival.json`, and aggregate `analysis.json`.

This target was audited only and left unchanged. A repair should include mismatched-endpoint distractors in ordinary teaching lessons and make the validator/domain contract explicit rather than exposing them only as a rejected degenerate texture.
